items.name: logs-ui
items.title: NocoBase Notification Logs UI
items.description: Application-owned delivery and provider attempt log components backed by the NocoBase notification API.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-notification and its authenticated /api/notifications/logs route. The installed source is application-owned and must be wired into an application route until the plugin exposes a stable client route contract.
